context: A treemap + sparkline dashboard showing synthetic annual revenue across 5 divisions (~100 products), with a KPI strip featuring mini sparklines and a bar chart.
first_impression: Structurally honest treemap with data-driven domains throughout, but sparkline areas use extent-based (non-zero) y-scales rather than absolute baselines.
what_works: Treemap cell area correctly encodes revenue via d3.hierarchy().sum(), all y-scales use d3.extent() or d3.max() — no hardcoded magic-number domains; KPI bar chart properly anchors at zero.
what_doesnt: Sparkline area fills (both in treemap cells and KPI strip) use d3.extent() y-domains, so the shaded area represents relative range not magnitude from zero — acceptable convention for sparklines but technically a soft baseline violation; no line.defined() guard exists, which would silently interpolate across any missing values.
